scope: AG06 dashboard assistant action account binding and durable outcome recovery
source_state: Owned AG06 sources frozen after 208 focused tests; parent owns final combined PostgreSQL acceptance and commit.
root_causes: Email and calendar previews froze content but not stable external account identity; reconnecting the same connector row could change the effect destination.
Text and voice WebSocket Apply consumed the proposal and omitted the saved receipt/status; a lost response could only produce an expired/ask-again error.
Readonly historical completion status alone did not establish current confirmation evidence.
EmailService401 refresh on direct callers did not compare the refreshed external account with the initial account.
Reminder and workflow success did not explicitly distinguish acknowledged local scheduling/per-step proof from an inferred historical completion.
Calendar update/cancel validated the reviewed event before awaited connector resolution, allowing a concurrent local event/account edit to retain stale approval.
changes: Server-only reviewed connector metadata is frozen by preview, stripped recursively from model arguments, and checked in existing services. Calendar event identity additionally includes recipients, state and reviewed content.
Support report sender is selected during review: pinned tenant provider or configured SMTP host/port/sender. Apply cannot change sender through fallback.
Current action permissions are rechecked after the durable claim and before invoking the effect service.
Both dashboard text and voice sockets support read-only proposal_status and recover consumed proposal receipts with the original actor/tenant/idempotency key.
Action list and actor-owned receipt GET expose allowlisted metadata/references only, with real filters/counts and no raw input/provider payload.
Durable row status remains separate from explicit saved success/confirmation; absent proof does not become confirmed completion. Provider acceptance is not delivery.
Shared executor preserves child_action_id when assigning the outer durable action ID.

Reminder confirmation now requires an acknowledged INSERT with a receipt ID. Workflow confirmation requires explicit proof for every executed step and a complete step-result inventory; skipped steps do not fabricate executed effects.
Safe action receipt references include reminder_id and plan_id. Scheduling acknowledgement is not reminder delivery.
Calendar update/cancel rereads the tenant-owned event after connector resolution and compares reviewed identity plus original account metadata before any effect.

initial_owned_tests.meaning: Missing reviewed identity input/preview data and receipt projection reproduced before implementation; no provider calls.

focused.command: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_ag06_dashboard_actions.py tests/unit/test_calendar_delivery_contract.py tests/unit/test_communication_delivery_contract.py tests/unit/assistant/test_execution_repairs.py tests/unit/assistant/test_dispatch_authorization.py tests/unit/test_assistant_ws.py tests/unit/test_assistant_agent_service.py tests/unit/test_email_service.py tests/unit/test_meeting_service.py tests/unit/test_report_issue_tool.py tests/unit/assistant/test_proposal_atomic.py -q --disable-warnings tests/unit/test_reminder_recipient_resolution.py

postgres_initial.evidence: Direct tool stdout:5passed in7.01s; parent final aggregate must rerun after later proof-projection tightening. No original log file was captured.

calendar_race_before.meaning: Changed event/attendees/account or deleted meeting during awaited resolution wrongly admitted update/cancel; unchanged positive controls passed. Synthetic connectors only.

acceptance_controls: Account switch after review and during definite401 refresh blocks sends; original same-account send returns actual mocked provider acknowledgement.
Changed or unproved calendar account/event/attendees/state cannot use an old approval.
Forged direct or nested review markers are stripped; permission revocation after claim prevents entry to effect tool.
Text and voice socket response loss then repeat Apply/Check status causes one dispatch for completed/running/unknown outcomes.
Actor and tenant isolation on recovery; missing record never suggests another effect; pending/running/unknown remain fenced.
Concurrent real PostgreSQL claims admit one synthetic effect; worker-object restart does not resend; post-effect local receipt loss retains running/unknown fences.
Scoped real HTTP activity filters/counts and receipt lookup do not expose body/token or another actor-owned detail.
Missing/empty/error reminder INSERT acknowledgement cannot confirm scheduling; valid local receipt exposes reminder_id without claiming delivery.
Workflow proof requires every executed result to explicitly authorize confirmation; missing/false proof, no executed steps, and incomplete inventories cannot confirm completion.
Calendar edit/delete/original-account change during awaited connector resolution blocks update/cancel before action creation and provider effect; unchanged targets remain usable.
limitations: No live connected account/provider/PSTN/browser delivery validation was performed in these backend tests.
Calendar records without stored stable original account identity remain unavailable for assistant update/cancel; reconnecting alone is not proof of historical event ownership.
Historical completed records without explicit confirmation evidence remain unverified.
Pending proposal previews are still process-local. A preview lost before any durable claim cannot be reconstructed as an approved effect.
No automatic retry or operator declaration of remote nonexecution was added. Unknown outcomes require original-account receipt inspection; code rollback does not undo remote effects.
Permission/account/source checks have an explicit admission boundary; subsequent external changes cannot be made atomic with a remote provider write.
